sample_job.raw_text: Looking for an experienced full-stack developer to build a customer-facing dashboard for our SaaS analytics product. Must have strong React and Python skills. The dashboard will display real-time metrics, charts, and allow users to configure alerts. We need someone who can work independently, write clean code, and deliver within 4 weeks. Experience with WebSockets and data visualization libraries is a plus. Budget: $5,000–$8,000.

sample_proposal.proposal_text:
Hi there,

I'm excited about this opportunity — building a customer-facing analytics dashboard is right in my wheelhouse. With 5+ years of full-stack experience specializing in React and Python, I've built very similar products and can hit the ground running.

Most recently, I built a real-time analytics dashboard for a SaaS startup that handles 10K+ concurrent users, using React for the frontend, D3.js for data visualization, and FastAPI with WebSocket streaming on the backend. That project is almost a blueprint for what you're describing — real-time metrics, interactive charts, and configurable alerts.

My approach would be to start with a clean component architecture in React + TypeScript, set up a FastAPI backend with WebSocket support for real-time data, and use D3.js (or Recharts for simpler chart needs) for the visualization layer. I'd deliver in iterative sprints with demos every week so we stay aligned.

I work independently, write well-documented code, and take ownership of the full delivery. I'd love to discuss the technical details and timeline with you.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Demonstrates strong React frontend skills and ability to deliver polished, conversion-focused user interfaces.
Shows backend API design expertise with FastAPI at scale — relevant to the dashboard's data layer.
